what: Settling time T_s - t0 (s) of every controller from the paper's S6 runs: 640 runs (2 scenarios x 8 arms x 40 topologies, seeds 300-339).

definition.series: per-tick user-to-user achievability min(100, 100 delivered/offered), percent; 1 tick = 1 s; MARL = replicate 1234 (arm marl_static)

A_cut.text: Scenario A, cut at t = 200 s

B_core.text: Scenario B, core loss at t = 0 s (window to 1400 s, reference = pre-surge mean of [900,1400))

B_surge.text: Scenario B, rescue surge at t = 1400 s

definition.moving_average: 10-tick CENTRED window x[t-5 .. t+4]; only windows wholly inside the window considered
definition.band: max(2.5 pp, 4 SD of the 10-s average inside the run's own reference window)
definition.T_s: first tick t >= t0 from which |MA - reference| <= band for every later moving average in the window considered; T_s = 1 + last tick out of band; T_s = t0 if never out of band; "never settles" if the last moving average is out of band
definition.best_routing: per topology the protocol with the shortest T_s of the four (a protocol that never settles counts as infinite); best_routing_paper = the protocol with the highest reference level on that topology (ties: shorter T_s)

series_equals_paper_per_seed.what: mean of the last 500 ticks of the extracted series == per_seed_300_339.json ach, every arm, seed, scenario
